## India: Regulatory & Legal Developments

The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has initiated the process for establishing India's Data Protection Board, inviting applications for key positions. This marks a significant step towards operationalizing the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023. ([Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxOTDZxU0lVa3BOWUF1Skp3a3VZczd2WTlOYmxtZDY1VGk5WUdjdmdlUlpDUGJVN1NlSW01YnpXVk9WUzdEQ3k5Z1UyWU9US0lsTUZBZnRnaEFCdG5kQ0Z4VllOaUtDUVE4ZzVMZzVUMV8wa2g5WDVpcXFGVmZQdDZtaThHZklEZnZNbWY5dUN3Y1A4ZnljMkRyN1NHbEw2aTRGUFBxLWotbjZkSnFuUWNrNTNFUVdSSlVE0gG-AUFVX3lxTFBNLTBmMHA3aDBJSnRfU2JKWlp5ekdISzdGRThYMjhZaEVOazBPNGNaQ05Ja1VaX2tCWnpRcEY5OGQ1Mm10eXd0a3NvbGdkZlpzZVNUVzBSNHcwdFBmS1FFY1o4OU5uQ3ZZUXJYTUcyTFI3YlBXcHBLRk1CbkN2czdiREIyaV9mdGtyNVNFY0lORzZjc0ZTQ1djSHMtTTZncWc1X2lqVEtMa052ZWg3TWlOSGlEdFl0TEgwRnNNZnc?oc=5))
